name: Kenya National Qualifications Framework levels
source: Kenya Law - The Kenya National Qualifications Framework (General) Regulations, 2025 (L.N. 94 of 2025), First Schedule Part 4 (Minimum Entry Requirements table)
notes: Reg. 7 sets KNQF levels one to ten. The 2025 Regulations revoke the KNQF Regulations 2018 (reg. 39). name = first qualification type listed for the level (verbatim, including the source's punctuation, e.g. level 7 'Bachelors' Degree or Professional or National Skills Certificate VI (NSC VI) Master Craft Person I'); notes = all qualification types for the level. In the source table some rows have an empty level cell; they were assigned to the level row above them (e.g. Higher National Diploma -> level 7; Post Graduate Diploma -> level 8). knqa.go.ke returned HTTP 500 at retrieval so KNQA's own publications could not be cross-checked.
